title: Tracked-machine initialization
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over Booleans and let $x$ be a Boolean input word. After one step from its initial configuration on $x$, the tracked machine is in the completed tracked configuration of $M$'s initial configuration, with both marker banks marking the origin on every tape.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
replaced:
For every machine $M$ and input $x$, one step of the tracked evaluator from its initial
configuration on $x$ equals the completed tracked configuration of the initial
configuration of $M$ on $x$ with all visited bounds zero: both marker banks hold origin
marks, the data bank is blank, and the output is empty.
